articles.title: From Balogun's Historic Brace to Curaçao's 17 Minutes of Glory: World Cup Week One Delivers
articles.summary: The U.S. men opened with a record 4-1 rout of Paraguay, powered by Folarin Balogun's two goals—the first multi-goal U.S. men's World Cup game since 1930. Tiny Curaçao, population 158,000, briefly tied Germany 1-1 before falling 7-1. Scotland stunned Haiti to top a group with Brazil.

articles.title: Cage Fights, a Peace Deal, and a Chain: Trump's Unprecedented 80th Birthday Bash
articles.summary: President Trump marked his 80th birthday by announcing an initial agreement to end the Iran war and hosting a UFC event on the White House South Lawn. Fighters praised Trump; one placed a chain around his neck and made a false claim about Michelle Obama. The celebration lasted past 1 a.m.

articles.title: Cape Verde's Debut Heroics: Spain Held Scoreless in World Cup Stunner
articles.summary: European champion Spain, among the pre-tournament favorites, was held to a shocking 0-0 draw by World Cup debutant Cape Verde, a nation of just over 500,000. Goalkeeper Vozinha made a series of crucial saves, and even the introduction of superstar Lamine Yamal couldn't break the deadlock. Cape Verde nearly won it at the death.
